title: Stable subject identity
statement: Bind each subject to immutable repository/product identity; names and counts are observations.
acceptance: Renaming a fixture retains its subject relationships and source lineage.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Current scope binding
statement: Resolve current accepted parent outcome, role and actual permissions before execution.
acceptance: A task without scope approval remains unclaimable for mutation.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Freshness boundary
statement: Record source revision, tool/config identity, timestamp and partial acquisition coverage.
acceptance: A stale observation cannot silently satisfy a current-revision query.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Local overlay identity
statement: Represent dirty/untracked authorized state separately from its base commit.
acceptance: Tests for the base commit cannot qualify changed overlay bytes.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Incremental invalidation
statement: Invalidate affected derived claims from changed inputs without erasing old evidence.
acceptance: A changed source invalidates dependent evidence and leaves unrelated valid evidence reusable.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Alias and lifecycle distinction
statement: Do not infer activity, archive, deletion or permission solely from topics/prefixes/404.
acceptance: Ambiguous access or conflicting role is explicit rather than classified as deleted.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Complete acquisition accounting
statement: Enumerate discovered, processed, inaccessible, excluded and unresolved sources.
acceptance: A partial source scan cannot be reported as a complete repository scan.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: No duplicate authority
statement: Reuse accepted source/work/evidence owners and generate projections.
acceptance: A generated document edit does not mutate real engine state.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Exact visible source preservation
statement: Preserve available exact human text separately from synthesis and raw-client claims.
acceptance: Captured text and digest agree; missing original timestamps remain unknown.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Normalized derivative identity
statement: Track normalization/redaction as derived records with source lineage.
acceptance: A normalized text cannot be labelled original byte capture.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Scoped supersession
statement: Link decisions to the exact scope and earlier decision they supersede.
acceptance: A one-repo approval cannot authorize a different repo operation.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Rationale distinction
statement: Separate historical explanation, inference and proposed rationale.
acceptance: Unsupported historical rationale is flagged rather than promoted as fact.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Conflicts visible
statement: Expose contradictory behavior, identity and ownership requirements for adjudication.

title: Future horizon preserved

title: Typed contracts

title: Stable identifiers

title: Critical invariants

title: Versioned public contracts

title: Unit floor

title: Integration floor

title: E2E floor

title: Metric independence
statement: Keep line, branch/decision, function and behavioral metrics distinct where supported.
acceptance: High line coverage cannot hide required low branch coverage.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Denominator provenance
statement: Inventory eligible zero-hit units and freeze reviewed denominator before interpreting results.
acceptance: Unknown/duplicate units and covered items outside denominator fail.

title: Critical completeness
statement: Cover and satisfy every finite enumerated critical obligation.
acceptance: Any missing critical item blocks regardless of percentage.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: All mandatory checks
statement: Run and pass required checks; missing, failed, skipped, crashed and timeout are nonaccepting.
acceptance: Empty selected checks or a skipped mandatory case cannot pass.

title: Independent run selection
statement: Do not combine accumulators or use one run identity as three independent suites.
acceptance: A mixed-family or reused run is rejected by the reference admission checks.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Unsupported measurements
statement: Expose measurement limitations and require an alternative/authorized exception.
acceptance: Unsupported or zero-denominator output is not 100 percent.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Negative controls
statement: Prove verifier failure on missing/malformed inputs and actual bad behavior.
acceptance: A seeded broken docs link or known-bad task causes the final gate to reject.

title: Trust boundary
statement: Separate payload integrity, producer authenticity and domain truth.
acceptance: A valid hash on a fabricated report never grants lifecycle approval.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Other required families
statement: Track security, fault, compatibility, performance, docs and delivery obligations independently.
acceptance: A required family absent from the support profile cannot disappear from acceptance silently.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Preservation contract
statement: State outputs, errors, side effects, ordering, cancellation and quality constraints before refactor.
acceptance: Differential/contract tests identify an intentional behavior change separately from parity.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Existing-solution assessment
statement: Compare standard facilities and maintained dependencies before handrolling large subsystems.

title: Wrapper restraint
statement: Wrap actual policy/stability boundaries, not every dependency method.
acceptance: A wrapper without useful contract difference is challenged as maintenance cost.

title: Patch provenance

verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Dead-code classification
statement: Distinguish accepted inactive, future, superseded, duplicate, optional and unknown behavior.

verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Consumer parity

acceptance: A filename match or clean patch application alone fails migration acceptance.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Maintenance evidence
statement: Measure custom concepts/glue/updates/cycles/release burden rather than LOC alone.
acceptance: A smaller implementation with worse resource/error behavior does not qualify.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Safe rollback
statement: Keep tested state/source recovery appropriate to each change.
acceptance: Git revert is not represented as a database restore.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Explicit applet manifest
statement: Declare capabilities, state, ports, permissions, lifecycle, resources and children.
acceptance: An unnamed shared mutable state fails boundary review.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Dependency direction

acceptance: Architecture tests detect forbidden dependency direction.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Behavioral substitutability
statement: Qualify adapters against errors, timing, data and cancellation contracts.
acceptance: Type compatibility alone cannot certify an adapter.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Recursive composition

verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Optional capability semantics

acceptance: Required missing backend is non-ready rather than mock healthy.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Locality-aware lowering
statement: Use direct/local paths unless isolation/placement cost justifies boundaries.
acceptance: A proposed RPC/microservice split records overhead and benefit.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: No forced repo split
statement: Applet identity does not itself create a repository or release requirement.
acceptance: New repo requires independent boundary/approval beyond a module name.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Lifecycle composition
statement: Specify startup, readiness, quiescence, cancellation, unmount and recovery.
acceptance: Parent shutdown does not leave unowned children or duplicate operations.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Current primary sources
statement: Pin versions and claim-specific sources before relying on external facts.
acceptance: A seed URL or vendor claim cannot be tagged independently measured.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Relevant research breadth
statement: Build relevant candidate longlists and justified executable shortlists.
acceptance: No duplicate/adjacent padding or unproved maximum claims.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Fair baseline
statement: Include competent direct/upstream/composed alternatives as appropriate.
acceptance: Owned preprocessing/setup is accounted for equivalently.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Modes separated
statement: Distinguish controlled replay, matched live and idiomatic whole-stack trials.
acceptance: Language/runtime differences are not attributed solely to framework design.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Ergonomics study
statement: Measure writing/testing/debugging/change/upgrade burden beyond LOC.
acceptance: At least one post-version-one change request is evaluated.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Safety and failure trials
statement: Inject representative interruption, malformed output, permission and resource failures.
acceptance: Success-only corpus cannot certify recovery/safety.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Uncertainty and retention
statement: Retain all outcomes and predeclare thresholds/stopping/analysis.
acceptance: Retries and inconclusive results remain in the final record.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Bounded claims
statement: Require hard invariants plus declared margins and meaningful advantage/distinct job.
acceptance: No universal winner or safety-compensating aggregate score is published.
verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.

title: Scoped permissions

verification: Contract/negative-control test plus independent source/runtime review as applicable; not executed product evidence.
